summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier) and SHACLPathError (direct Exception subclass). Added test/test_extras/test_extras_shacl.py with a parametrized test over valid and invalid Turtle shapes, plus a non-node input test. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (39 passed). Not verified: mypy, black, isort, and flake8 are not installed in the shared venv, and I did not install them. Line lengths were checked by hand (none over 88). Nothing was committed; the core path module and package __init__ files are unchanged.
